THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Cottage-Cheese Marry Me Chicken

Marry Me chicken, zero heavy cream. One chicken pan, two pasta plates—and 53g protein on the adult plate.

YIELD8 servings
TOTAL TIME35 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~450 cal | ~53g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Blend the 440g Good Culture 2% cottage cheese, 1/4 cup Nurri whole protein milk, 60g grated Parmesan/Romano/Asiago blend, and garlic seasoning until completely smooth before heating the sauce.

Ingredients

Shared

  • 3 lb raw, trimmed boneless skinless chicken thighs + 1 tbsp sun-dried-tomato jar oil
  • Garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt & pepper
  • 2 minced garlic cloves + 60g drained bettergoods diced sun-dried tomatoes
  • 1/2 cup Kirkland chicken bone broth + 5 oz fresh spinach
  • 440g Good Culture 2% cottage cheese + 1/4 cup Nurri whole protein milk + 60g Kraft grated Parmesan/Romano/Asiago blend

Adult Plate — 1/8 Chicken & Sauce + 56g Dry Carbe Diem Penne (~450 cal / 53g protein)

  • 56g dry Carbe Diem penne per adult plate
  • Red chili flakes to taste (about 1/2 tsp)

Kid Plate — Mild Shared Chicken & Sauce + Regular Barilla Pasta

  • 42g dry regular Barilla pasta per kid plate (or portion to suit appetite)

You want a rich, restaurant-style Marry Me chicken pasta dinner with zero heavy cream that hits ~450 calories and 53g protein per adult plate (with 56g dry Carbe Diem penne) while feeding the whole family from one chicken skillet.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.Blend cottage cheese, milk, grated three-cheese blend, and garlic seasoning until completely smooth.
  2. 2.Pat chicken thighs dry, season, and sear in batches in 1 tbsp tomato-jar oil until browned and at least 165°F internally. Rest and chop into bite-size pieces.
  3. 3.Lower heat, briefly cook drained sun-dried tomatoes and minced garlic, deglaze with 1/2 cup bone broth, and wilt 5 oz spinach.
  4. 4.Take pan off heat briefly, temper a little warm pan liquid into the blended sauce, return the chopped chicken, and fold in the sauce over lowest heat without boiling.

Adult Plate — 1/8 Chicken & Sauce + 56g Dry Carbe Diem Penne (~450 cal / 53g protein)

  1. 5.Cook 56g dry Carbe Diem penne per adult plate according to package directions.
  2. 6.Top with 1/8 of the shared Marry Me chicken and cottage-cheese cream sauce batch and finish with red chili flakes (~450 cal, 53g protein, 44g total carbs, 25g fiber, 15g fat).

Kid Plate — Mild Shared Chicken & Sauce + Regular Barilla Pasta · Kid Plate — Mild Shared Chicken & Sauce + Regular Barilla Pasta

  1. 5.Cook regular Barilla pasta separately and serve with a kid-sized portion of the mild shared Marry Me chicken and sauce (skip the chili flakes; no public child macro target is claimed).

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult Plate — 1/8 Chicken & Sauce + 56g Dry Carbe Diem Penne (~450 cal / 53g protein): Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid Plate — Mild Shared Chicken & Sauce + Regular Barilla Pasta: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Cook the adult Carbe Diem pasta and kid regular Barilla pasta in separate pots according to package directions, and reserve a little starchy pasta water.
  • Sear the seasoned chicken thighs in batches in 1 tbsp sun-dried-tomato jar oil until browned and at least 165°F internally; rest and cut into bite-size pieces.

If something fails

Cottage-cheese cream sauce separates or turns grainy in the skillet: Never boil the blended sauce. Take the skillet off the heat briefly, stir a splash of warm pan liquid into the blender cup to temper it, then fold into the chicken over the lowest heat setting so it steams gently without bubbling.

Sauce thickens too much when coating the chicken: Loosen with a splash of reserved pasta water while stirring gently over low heat.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store the cooked chicken-and-sauce batch and the cooked pastas in separate airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 3–4 days.

Reheat: Warm gently on low heat or at 50% microwave power with a splash of reserved pasta water or milk so the cottage-cheese sauce stays smooth.

Lasts: Up to 3–4 days refrigerated (enough for 2 family dinners for 3 adults and 2 kids).

Estimated nutrition

~450 cal | ~53g protein.

Whole chicken-and-sauce pan (8 adult-equivalent portions): ~2,684.8 calories, 361.7g protein, 34.9g total carbs, 117.0g fat, 8.2g fiber (~335.6 cal / 45.2g protein per 1/8 pan). Adult plate adds 56g dry Carbe Diem penne (110 cal, 8g protein, 40g total carbs, 24g fiber, 0.5g fat) for ~445.6 calories, 53.2g protein, 44.4g total carbs, 25.0g fiber, and 15.1g fat—rounded to ≈450 calories and 53g protein. Anchored on 3 lb raw trimmed boneless skinless chicken thighs (USDA FDC 173627; 1,646.5 cal, 267.5g protein), 440g Good Culture 2% cottage cheese (360 cal, 56g protein), 1/4 cup Nurri whole protein milk (42.5 cal, 5g protein), 60g Kraft grated Parmesan/Romano/Asiago blend (240 cal, 24g protein), 60g drained bettergoods sun-dried tomatoes (~207.7 cal), 1 tbsp tomato-jar oil (119 cal, 13.5g fat), 1/2 cup Kirkland chicken bone broth (22.5 cal, 4.5g protein), 5 oz raw spinach (32.6 cal, 4.1g protein), 2 garlic cloves (8.9 cal), and seasoning allowance (5 cal). Kids’ plates use regular Barilla pasta and smaller chicken/sauce portions and are not described by the adult macro estimate.
